name: Stalwart Marketing
description: Use a self-hosted Stalwart JMAP API to send batch marketing emails.
author: YourName

base_url.label: Stalwart URL
base_url.description: Your Stalwart JMAP URL or HTTP origin, for example https://email.postion.app/jmap

username.label: JMAP Username
username.description: Stalwart account or app username for Basic auth

password.label: JMAP Password
password.description: Stalwart password or app password for Basic auth

bearer_token.label: Bearer Token
bearer_token.description: OAuth bearer token when auth_type is bearer

account_id.label: JMAP Account ID
account_id.description: Optional. Leave empty to use the primary mail account from the JMAP session.

identity_id.label: JMAP Identity ID
identity_id.description: Optional. Leave empty to use the first identity returned by Identity/get.

draft_mailbox_id.label: Draft Mailbox ID
draft_mailbox_id.description: Optional. Leave empty to use the mailbox whose JMAP role is drafts.

batch_size.label: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Maximum recipients submitted to Stalwart in one JMAP request

max_send_recipients.label: Max Campaign Recipients
max_send_recipients.description: Maximum recipients accepted for one marketing send request

delay_ms.label: Delay Milliseconds
delay_ms.description: Delay between recipients to reduce burst pressure

timeout.label: Timeout Seconds
timeout.description: HTTP timeout for Stalwart API requests

queue_retry_enabled.label: Retry Scheduler
queue_retry_enabled.description: Reserved switch for future queued campaign retries
